mapper.select: select r.id, r.student_name, r.score, r.exam_id, p.name paper_name, p.total_score paper_total_score, r.start_time, r.end_time, TIMESTAMPDIFF(minute, r.start_time, r.end_time) duration from exam_records r join paper p on r.exam_id = p.id where r.is_deleted = 0 and p.is_deleted = 0 and r.status='已批阅' and p.id = #{paperId} order by r.score desc, duration asc limit #{limit}
